sloka: महाभागेन रामेण पापः करुण वेदिना ।हरीणाम् प्रापितो राज्यम् त्वम् दुरात्मा महात्मना ॥४-३४-१६॥
transliteration: mahābhāgena rāmeṇa pāpaḥ karuṇa vedinā ।harīṇām prāpito rājyam tvam durātmā mahātmanā ॥4-34-16॥

translations.english: 'Rama is illustrious, compassionate and great. He has granted the kingdom to you, to one who is a sinner and an evilminded person.
